referenceName: Greystar: renter search, apartment discovery, and city guides

source.name: Greystar official website
source.sourceType: official direct rental housing and property management website captured in Playwright Chromium
source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance dated 2026-09-29 covers internal desktop and mobile screenshot retention, derived design prompts, and pipeline-model reference use. No source-owner grant was supplied or independently verified.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A bright bedroom image supports a centered search card; an immediate apartment carousel follows with rent context. The next sections mix a short renting rationale with a large resident-life photograph, three practical benefit stories, a horizontally browsable city selector, useful moving and rental-safety guides, and a partner/contact close. A local apartment directory and a formal corporate footer finish the long page. The composition serves a renter through a search-first task path, not through luxury branding. Source property names, rates, locations, people, and operational claims do not transfer.

heroGeometry.mode: bright rental search console over domestic image
heroGeometry.alignment: centered light search surface layered over a full-width interior scene
heroGeometry.viewport: search for a home or community is the first practical decision

navigationGeometry.placement: slim utility header with resident tools and business contact
navigationGeometry.mobile: collapse utility items while retaining a visible search field and resident support route

palette.contrastIntent: highly legible utility controls and housing information across bright surfaces

imageTreatment.crop: large bedroom hero followed by community, city, and lived-in moments
imageTreatment.focalPoint: show practical residential spaces and people with room around overlay text

servicePresentation.interaction: browse places with location and rent context, then read decision-support content for tours and moving

ctaPlacement.primary: search rental homes by city or community
ctaPlacement.secondary: learn about renting or contact resident support
ctaPlacement.early: rental location search in hero console

motion.reducedMotion: render the first community cards in a static list and keep all links available

mobileRecomposition.strategy: renter search console then one column communities
rules: keep the search action visible without scrolling through explanation
stack the community cards with full rent context
convert city and guide rails into touch-safe rows
preserve resident support and access links in the compact menu

prohibitedPatterns: copying Greystar identity, apartment images, prices, community names, people, rates, or scale claims
presenting a managed property as the client's own without proof
inventing rent, fees, availability, amenities, or resident services
placing text over a busy resident photograph
turning search results or renter advice into one undifferentiated card wall

requiredSignatureElements.description: A location or community search is the primary opening interaction.
Places are browseable with verified location and pricing context.
Useful renter guidance appears before the close and answers real customer questions.

acceptanceChecks: Opening search and resident-help actions are distinct.
Rental costs and availability are shown only if supplied and current.
Community cards remain usable on touch devices without horizontal page overflow.
Renter advice is factual and tied to the client's actual service.
No source location, property, person, pricing, or scale claim is presented as client proof.

review.notes: Official site identifies Greystar's apartment discovery and resident-help routes. Full-page home captures were inspected after optional cookies were rejected; HTTP 200 at both viewports, no broken content images or page errors, with some unresolved lazy image elements at the time of capture.
